decisions.reason: As a very new automation offering in a German machinery firm, the limited but continued website presence suggests results are still being judged under uncertainty, and with no clear shortfall versus aspiration the firm would likely keep it while learning.

This newly launched loading system shows only basic market presence and thus somewhat higher uncertainty, but absent evidence of underperformance the firm would usually retain it for another year rather than redeploy resources immediately.

The dedicated product page and the 2024 Red Dot design award are positive signals that likely place the product at or above aspiration, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it in the next year.
